title: Integral coefficient rings and homological dimensions of algebras
summary: We define the integral profiles of all modules and introduce integral coefficient rings ${^{\mathscr{P}}\mkern-6.5mu\text{\&}\mkern-5.5mu{_\mathscr{I}}}(A)$ for all finite-dimensional complex algebras $A$. The integral profile of a module is a matrix with parameters. We provide a classification theorem for modules, to be precise, (1) two modules $M\cong N$ are isomorphic if and only if their integral profiles are similar, i.e., $M\cong N$ if and only if $\displaystyle \int M \sim \int N$.
